eSIM terms, demystified
Traveling with an eSIM comes with a handful of acronyms. Here's a plain-English glossary of the eSIM and mobile-data terms you'll actually run into.
A
- APNCore
- Access Point Name. The setting that tells your device how to reach a mobile-data network. Travel eSIMs normally configure it for you, so you rarely need to change it.
- See also: MNO
